decisions.rationale: Prevents callback nesting from accumulating over repeated stop/start cycles; no configuration or operator procedure changes.
evidence: [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md): Repeated software PWM stop and restart cycles no longer accumulate callback nesting.
